items.question: Within how many days will a covered item under warranty be repaired after the retailer receives it?
items.gold: Within 14 days from the date the item is received for repair, subject to spare parts availability.
items.fact: Covered items are repaired within 14 days of receipt.

items.question: For how long does the warranty cover defects in materials and workmanship under normal use?
items.gold: 1 year from the date of purchase.
items.fact: Warranty covers defects for one year from purchase date.
